extDescription.message: Speaks the seconds remaining on your chess.com clock so you never lose on time.

sectionMasterDesc.message: Pause every announcement without losing your settings.

masterToggleHelp.message: Turn off to silence the extension instantly.

clockScopeHelp.message: Opponent announcements require their clock to be running.

sectionBehaviorDesc.message: Control which clocks speak and how increment is handled.

incrementAwareHelp.message: Subtract the increment from the threshold (never below 5 seconds) because you are about to get time back.

sectionAnnouncementDesc.message: Choose the words and the rhythm of the countdown.

phraseHelp.message: Use tokens to build the phrase. Keep it short so it finishes in about one second.

cadenceHelp.message: Every second is most informative; panic and milestones are less chatty.

milestonesHelp.message: Comma-separated values used by the milestones cadence.

sectionSpeechDesc.message: Voices are provided by your browser and operating system.

voiceHelp.message: Pick a specific voice, or let the browser match the language.

voiceUnavailable.message: No speech voices were found. Install a system voice or check your browser's speech settings. Announcements will use the default voice.

thresholdHelp.message: Announces each whole second at or below this time.

tcHelpBullet.message: Bullet defaults to 50 seconds and can never exceed 60.

tcHelpBlitz.message: Blitz defaults to 20 seconds and can never exceed 300.

tcHelpRapid.message: Rapid defaults to 20 seconds and can never exceed 900.

tcHelpDaily.message: Daily clocks barely tick; off by default.

sectionPresetsDesc.message: One click fills the phrase, cadence, milestones, and rate. Save your own from the current settings.

presetPanicDesc.message: Every second under 10, every 5 seconds above.

presetApplied.message: Preset applied. Save changes to keep it.

saveCurrentPreset.message: Save the current phrase as a preset

saveCurrentPresetHelp.message: Captures the phrase, cadence, milestones, and rate.

presetNameRequired.message: Enter a name for the preset.

aboutFairPlayBody.message: This extension only reads the clock text on chess.com and speaks the time. It never reads the board, suggests moves, or touches the game.

aboutPrivacyBody.message: Settings stay in chrome.storage.sync. No analytics, no remote code, no accounts, and no data leaves your browser.

resetConfirm.message: Reset every setting to its default value?

enableMasterHint.message: Turn on the master switch above to hear clock announcements.

optionsSubtitle.message: Choose when the clock speaks, what it says, and how it sounds. Settings sync through chrome.storage.sync.

optionsFooterNote.message: Reads only the clock. No board access, no move suggestions, no analytics.

testVoiceUnavailable.message: Speech synthesis is not available in this browser.

errorThresholdRange.message: Use a whole number between $MIN$ and $MAX$ seconds.

errorPhraseLength.message: Phrase is too long. Keep it to 40 characters or fewer.

errorPhraseDuration.message: This phrase is too long to speak in about one second. Shorten it.

errorMilestones.message: Enter comma-separated whole seconds, for example 10, 5, 3, 2, 1.
